reference: All 81 original boundary worlds and all three original truth suites; unchanged maximum 65536-path finite references with separately corrected pointwise query certification
generator: Original historical growth and observation estimator; freeze attribution before corrected-generator comparison
information: E00 engine accepts strict observation packet, disclosed B0 context, public E0 anchor and fitted model only. Oracle payloads enter other explicit interfaces only. No oracle stage selection or refitting.

convergence.extension_stream: oracle_future(world,draw,chunk), identical seed across roles but variable-consumption coupling not exact across changed states/params

axes.1,2: Observation packet only; original inference and future streams held
axes.3,4: State/parameter inference seeds only; original packet and future streams held
axes.5,6: Future seed only; original packet and inference streams held

replicate_panel.selection: Fixed spread of roster indices, not selected by error or oracle benefit

misalignment: Prediction kernel stays nominal in all four conditions. Hemlock hazard supplement and annual lognormal entry dispersion remain absent even when true state/nominal parameters are supplied; E11 does not remove misspecification or finite MC.
contrasts: L00-L10; L00-L01; interaction L11-L10-L01+L00; signed paired contrasts, never forced additive causal shares
uncertainty: Pointwise design-conditional Wilson for classifier rates; paired constructed-world bootstrap stratified by world family; fixed future prefixes and separate observation/estimator replicate panel. No ecological population interval.
selection: All worlds, suites, queries, conditions and prefixes retained including unfavorable or unresolved cases; no adjusted truth or tuned estimator
